description.en: Spring AI · AI Agents · Tool Calling · RAG Knowledge Bases · Vector Retrieval

description.en: Multi-module backend systems with service splitting, messaging, distributed coordination, orders, payments, and search.
description.zh: 多模块后端系统，覆盖服务拆分、消息队列、分布式协作、订单支付与搜索等能力。

description.en: Spring Boot business systems for local-life services, catering, campaigns, user flows, and high-concurrency scenarios.
description.zh: 基于 Spring Boot 的业务系统项目，覆盖本地生活、餐饮、活动营销、用户流程与高并发场景。

imageAlt.zh: 天机学堂在线教育平台封面

title.zh: 天机学堂在线教育平台

description.en: A Spring Cloud microservices online education platform covering course management, online learning, course purchases and payments, exam practice, media, messages, search, and analytics.
description.zh: 基于 Spring Cloud 微服务架构的在线教育平台，覆盖课程管理、在线学习、支付购买、考试练习、媒资、消息、搜索与数据看板等核心场景。

intro.en: Explore how domain services, course publishing, and student commerce fit together.
intro.zh: 通过架构分层、课程发布和学习购买流程，了解平台核心模块如何协作。

caption.en: Gateway routes requests to identity, learning, commerce, content, and insight services, supported by shared infrastructure.
caption.zh: 网关连接认证、学习、交易、内容与数据服务，并由公共基础设施提供支撑。

alt.en: Tianjixuetang microservice architecture showing gateway, domain services, and shared infrastructure
alt.zh: 天机学堂微服务架构图，展示 API 网关、领域服务与共享基础设施

caption.en: Course information, teachers, catalogue chapters, and media are configured before review and listing.
caption.zh: 课程信息、教师、章节目录与媒资配置完成后，进入审核和上架流程。

alt.en: Course management view illustrating course details, teacher association, catalogue chapters, and draft review
alt.zh: 课程管理界面示意图，展示课程信息、教师关联、章节目录与草稿审核

title.zh: 从课程购买到在线学习

caption.en: Course discovery leads to order checkout and payment, then unlocks course access and progress tracking.
caption.zh: 课程浏览进入下单与支付，完成后开通课程权限并持续记录学习进度。

alt.en: Student journey from course discovery through checkout and payment to learning access and progress tracking
alt.zh: 学员旅程图：课程发现、确认订单、完成支付、获得学习权限并追踪进度

en: Organized gateway, authentication, course, learning, exam, media, trade, pay, message, search, and data services with Nacos configuration and Feign calls
Implemented course lifecycle features including category management, catalog chapters, teacher binding, video upload, question binding, and listing review workflow
Built course purchase flow from login, browsing, cart, order confirmation, payment, permission acquisition, and learning access
Integrated Redis, Redisson, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, cloud media storage, and SMS notifications for distributed business scenarios
zh: 按网关、认证、课程、学习、考试、媒资、交易、支付、消息、搜索与数据等服务拆分架构，结合 Nacos 配置与 Feign 通信
实现课程分类、章节目录、教师关联、视频上传、题目绑定与上架审核等课程生命周期功能
打通课程购买流程：登录、浏览课程、加入购物车、确认订单、支付、获得课程权限并开始学习
整合 Redis、Redisson、RabbitMQ、Elasticsearch、云媒资存储与短信通知，支撑分布式业务场景

imageAlt.en: Xiaozhong Dianping local life review backend cover
imageAlt.zh: 小众点评本地生活点评系统封面

title.en: Xiaozhong Dianping Local Life Review System
title.zh: 小众点评本地生活点评系统

description.en: A Spring Boot backend for local-life reviews, supporting user login, shop queries, blog sharing, social interactions, voucher release, and flash-sale coupon purchasing.
description.zh: 基于 Spring Boot 的本地生活点评系统后端，支持用户登录、商铺查询、博客分享、社交互动、优惠券发放与秒杀抢购。

intro.en: Follow the core product journeys from finding a shop to sharing an experience and claiming a voucher.
intro.zh: 从商铺查找、探店分享，到优惠券领取与秒杀下单，浏览项目覆盖的核心业务场景。

caption.en: Browse shops by type or search by name, then open a shop record for its local-life details.
caption.zh: 按商铺类型浏览或根据名称搜索，并进入商铺详情查看本地生活信息。

alt.en: Illustrative shop discovery interface with category filters, name search, and shop result cards
alt.zh: 商铺发现界面示意图，展示类型筛选、名称搜索和商铺结果卡片

caption.en: Publish local-life notes, browse hot blogs, and interact through likes, comments, and follow relationships.
caption.zh: 发布本地生活博客、浏览热门内容，并通过点赞、评论与关注关系进行互动。

alt.en: Illustrative community blog interface with a local-life post, hot content list, and like and comment actions
alt.zh: 社区博客界面示意图，展示本地生活帖子、热门内容列表以及点赞和评论操作

caption.en: Trace voucher discovery and the seckill order request through the service, Redis practice, and MySQL persistence.
caption.zh: 展示优惠券查询与秒杀请求在服务端的处理，以及 Redis 实践和 MySQL 数据持久化。

alt.en: Illustrative voucher flow connecting a user purchase request, backend handling, Redis, and MySQL order data
alt.zh: 优惠券流程示意图，连接用户抢购请求、后端处理、Redis 与 MySQL 订单数据

en: Built user authentication with mobile verification code login, session management, and current-user context storage
Developed shop and blog modules supporting shop lookup, category queries, blog publishing, likes, hot blog ranking, and user blog lists
Implemented voucher management and flash-sale purchasing flows with Redis-based caching and distributed-lock practice
Structured the backend around controller, service, mapper, DTO, entity, and utility layers using MyBatis-Plus with MySQL persistence
zh: 实现手机号验证码登录、Session 会话管理与当前用户上下文存储
完成商铺与博客模块，支持商铺查询、分类筛选、博客发布、点赞、热门博客与用户博客列表
实现优惠券管理与秒杀抢购流程，结合 Redis 缓存与分布式锁练习高并发处理
基于 MyBatis-Plus 与 MySQL 持久化，按 controller、service、mapper、DTO、entity 与 utils 分层组织后端代码

imageAlt.en: AI Draw.io project overview: human and AI diagram editing, six backend modules, MCP and Skills
imageAlt.zh: AI Draw.io 项目概览：人机协作绘图、后端六模块、MCP 与 Skills 工具装配

title.en: AI Agent Scaffold Lite / AI Draw.io
title.zh: AI Agent Scaffold Lite / AI 交互绘图

description.en: An AI diagramming application built on a six-module Java / Spring Boot Agent scaffold. A Next.js frontend embeds Draw.io for conversational diagram generation, manual editing, and further AI revisions using the current diagram.
description.zh: 基于 Java / Spring Boot 六模块 Agent 脚手架，扩展出 AI 交互绘图应用。Next.js 前端嵌入 Draw.io，支持对话生成图表、手动编辑，并携带当前图继续由 AI 修改。

heading.zh: AI 交互绘图与智能体架构

intro.en: The diagramming flow, six backend modules, and reusable Agent assembly. Select a diagram to enlarge it.
intro.zh: 交互绘图流程、后端六模块与可复用的 Agent 装配。点击设计图，查看完整细节。

title.zh: AI Draw.io · 对话生成、手动编辑与迭代修改

caption.en: A request passes through analysis, drawing, and review agents. A user response requests clarification; a drawio response loads XML into the canvas. The next request can include manually edited XML. Browser history uses localStorage; backend sessions use InMemoryRunner.
caption.zh: 请求依次经过需求分析、绘图和检查 Agent；user 响应补充信息，drawio 响应加载 XML 到画布。后续请求可携带手动编辑后的 XML；浏览器历史保存在 localStorage，后端会话使用 InMemoryRunner。

alt.en: AI Draw.io interaction flow from a Next.js frontend through HTTP session APIs and three sequential agents to XML rendering, manual edits, and optional diagram context for the next request
alt.zh: AI Draw.io 交互流程：Next.js 前端经 HTTP 会话接口调用三个顺序 Agent，返回 XML 渲染到画布，支持手动编辑并按需携带当前图继续对话

title.zh: DDD 六模块 · 工程职责架构图

caption.en: A Next.js / Draw.io frontend calls the HTTP endpoints in Trigger. App loads configuration, Domain assembles agents and handles in-memory sessions, and API / Types define shared contracts. Infrastructure remains an extension skeleton.
caption.zh: Next.js / Draw.io 前端调用 Trigger 的 HTTP 接口；App 加载配置，Domain 负责 Agent 装配和内存会话，API / Types 定义契约与通用类型；Infrastructure 仍以扩展骨架为主。

alt.en: AI Draw.io frontend and six backend modules, including implemented HTTP endpoints and in-memory chat sessions, with Infrastructure marked as an extension skeleton
alt.zh: AI Draw.io 前端与后端六模块架构：已实现 HTTP 接口、内存会话与 Agent 装配，Infrastructure 标明为扩展骨架

title.zh: Agent 装配 · 顺序、并行与循环协作

caption.en: Configuration assembles API, model, agents, workflows, and runner. MCP strategies and directory / classpath Skills become model tool callbacks. Sequential, parallel, and loop collaboration examples remain available; AI Draw.io uses the sequential analysis, drawing, and review flow.
caption.zh: 配置依次装配 API、模型、Agent、工作流与 Runner；MCP 策略和目录 / 类路径 Skills 统一挂载为模型工具回调。保留顺序、并行、循环示例；AI Draw.io 当前采用分析、绘图、检查的顺序流程。

alt.en: Configuration-driven Agent assembly with MCP and Skills callbacks, plus sequential, parallel, and loop examples; the drawing runner uses the sequential workflow
alt.zh: 配置驱动 Agent 装配，接入 MCP 与 Skills 工具回调，并展示顺序、并行、循环示例；绘图 Runner 使用顺序流程

en: Runs analysis, drawing, and review agents in sequence to generate Draw.io XML or ask for clarification
Embeds an editable Draw.io canvas in Next.js / TypeScript, with optional diagram context, SVG export, and browser-local conversation history
Exposes Agent listing, session creation, and chat HTTP APIs; keeps backend sessions in InMemoryRunner
Reuses six DDD backend modules and configuration-driven assembly, with Local / SSE / Stdio MCP tools and directory / classpath Skills callbacks
Provides Docker Compose deployment for frontend and backend, with environment-based model keys and API address configuration
zh: 通过需求分析、绘图、检查三个 Agent 顺序协作，生成 Draw.io XML 或提示用户补充信息
以 Next.js / TypeScript 嵌入可编辑 Draw.io 画布，支持按需携带当前图、SVG 导出与浏览器本地会话历史
实现智能体列表、创建会话、对话 HTTP 接口，后端会话由 InMemoryRunner 在内存中维护
复用 DDD 后端六模块与配置驱动装配，接入 Local / SSE / Stdio MCP 工具及目录 / 类路径 Skills 回调
提供前后端 Docker Compose 部署配置，通过环境变量配置模型密钥与 API 地址

imageAlt.en: CampusAI product interface design showing chat, tool calling, and conversation memory
imageAlt.zh: CampusAI 产品界面设计：智能对话、工具调用与会话记忆

description.en: A campus assistant built with Spring AI, connecting conversational services, business tool calling, and RAG search across announcements and documents.
description.zh: 基于 Spring AI 的园区智能助手，将智能对话、业务工具调用与公告、资料的 RAG 检索串联起来。

intro.en: Explore the service architecture, the tool execution loop, and the announcement knowledge pipeline. Select an image to view the details.
intro.zh: 从系统分层到工具执行，再到公告知识检索，三张设计图呈现核心链路。点击图片查看细节。

caption.en: The user interface, AI services, management services, and shared data infrastructure.
caption.zh: 用户界面、AI 服务、园区业务与数据基础设施的职责分层。

alt.en: CampusAI system architecture: Vue, Spring AI, RuoYi, RabbitMQ, MySQL, Redis Stack, MinIO, and model services
alt.zh: CampusAI 系统架构：Vue、Spring AI、若依、RabbitMQ、MySQL、Redis Stack、MinIO 与模型服务

caption.en: The model requests a tool; the application executes the business action and returns its result.
caption.zh: 模型提出工具调用请求，应用执行业务动作，再将结果回填模型。

alt.en: CampusAI tool calling design from user context and prompt assembly to tool execution and a final response
alt.zh: CampusAI 工具调用设计：用户上下文、提示词构造、模型决策、应用执行与最终回答

caption.en: Asynchronous content indexing and semantic retrieval connect maintained knowledge to conversational answers.
caption.zh: 通过异步内容索引与语义检索，将维护中的知识连接到对话回答。

alt.en: CampusAI announcement and document indexing through RabbitMQ and Redis Stack, followed by Spring AI RAG question answering
alt.zh: CampusAI 公告与资料通过 RabbitMQ、Redis Stack 完成知识索引，并由 Spring AI 进行 RAG 问答

en: Built an AI assistant with Spring AI, supporting conversational Q&A, prompt optimization, and conversation memory persistence in MySQL
Implemented Function Calling to collect user information automatically, write it into the database, and update session context dynamically
Developed a conversational announcement system with vectorized storage and retrieval, enabling natural-language question answering
Built a RAG knowledge base on Redis Stack, combining vector retrieval with LLM generation for intelligent document search and summarization
zh: 基于 Spring AI 集成大模型，开发 AI 助手，实现对话问答、提示词优化与 MySQL 会话记忆存储
基于 Function Calling 实现用户信息自动采集与入库，并动态更新会话上下文
实现对话式公告系统，完成公告向量化存储与检索，支持自然语言问答
基于 Redis Stack 构建 RAG 知识库，结合向量检索与大模型生成，实现文档智能检索与总结

imageAlt.en: Red Packet Rain Lottery System cover

description.en: Enterprise-level lottery activity management platform, supporting red packet rain, lottery events, prizes, and member management. Suitable for high-concurrency scenarios such as corporate annual meetings and holiday events.
description.zh: 面向企业活动场景的抽奖管理平台，支持红包雨、奖品管理与会员管理，适用于年会与节日等高并发活动。

intro.en: Explore activity configuration, participation statistics, winner records, and the request processing flow.
intro.zh: 查看活动配置、参与统计与中奖记录，以及抽奖请求的服务端处理流程。

caption.en: Configure activity timing and types, maintain prizes, and set participation rules by membership level.
caption.zh: 配置活动时段与类型，维护奖品信息，并按会员等级设置参与规则。

alt.en: Illustrative activity configuration console with activity timing, lottery types, member rules, and prize management
alt.zh: 活动配置后台示意图，展示活动时段、抽奖类型、会员规则与奖品管理

caption.en: Review participation and winning summaries alongside activity, member, and prize details in winner records.
caption.zh: 集中查看参与和中奖概况，并通过中奖记录关联活动、会员与奖品明细。

alt.en: Illustrative activity dashboard with participation and winning summaries, statistics dimensions, and winner record fields
alt.zh: 活动看板示意图，展示参与和中奖概况、统计维度与中奖记录字段

caption.en: Trace the time-random lottery path through activity checks, Redis and Lua token validation, and RabbitMQ consumers that persist participation and winning records.
caption.zh: 以时间随机玩法为例，展示活动规则检查、Redis 与 Lua 令牌校验，以及 RabbitMQ 消息消费和记录写入。

alt.en: Request flow diagram showing participant, activity checks, Redis and Lua token validation, lottery result, RabbitMQ, and MySQL records
alt.zh: 抽奖请求流程图，展示参与者、活动检查、Redis 与 Lua 令牌校验、抽奖结果、RabbitMQ 和 MySQL 记录

en: Developed User and Activity modules with accurate real-time data display for frontend
Optimized high-concurrency using Redis preloading and token bucket + Lua scripts to prevent overselling
Implemented asynchronous lottery processing with RabbitMQ for improved system stability
Achieved QPS of 2312 on core interfaces through JMeter performance testing
zh: 完成用户与活动模块开发，保障前端实时数据展示准确
通过 Redis 预热与令牌桶 + Lua 脚本优化并发，避免超卖
引入 RabbitMQ 异步抽奖流程，提升系统稳定性
核心接口压测达到 2312 QPS

description.en: A catering management system with frontend-backend separation, including a merchant backend management system and a user mini program. Supports dishes, set meals, categories, and orders, optimizing user ordering experience and merchant management efficiency.
description.zh: 前后端分离的餐饮管理系统，包含商家后台与用户端小程序，覆盖菜品、套餐、分类与订单等核心流程。

intro.en: Explore merchant operations, the customer ordering journey, and the Spring Boot services behind both sides. The repository includes a sample mini program for integration testing.
intro.zh: 从商家运营、用户点餐到 Spring Boot 服务协作，了解系统的主要业务链路。仓库内含用于联调的示例小程序。

caption.en: Manage staff, categories, dishes, set meals, store status, and order records from the merchant side.
caption.zh: 在商家端管理员工、分类、菜品、套餐、门店营业状态与订单记录。

alt.en: Illustrative merchant console showing store operations, employee and category management, dishes, set meals, and order records
alt.zh: 商家后台界面示意图，展示门店运营、员工与分类管理、菜品、套餐及订单记录

caption.en: Follow category browsing and item selection through cart updates, delivery details, order submission, and payment. The repository's mini program is provided as an integration sample.
caption.zh: 串联分类浏览、菜品选择、购物车调整、收货信息、订单提交与支付；仓库中的小程序为联调示例。

alt.en: Illustrative ordering flow with category browsing, dish and set meal selection, shopping cart, delivery details, and order submission
alt.zh: 点餐流程示意图，展示分类浏览、菜品与套餐选择、购物车、收货信息和订单提交

title.zh: 前后端协同与数据服务

caption.en: See how merchant and customer requests reach Spring Boot services backed by Redis, MySQL, and Aliyun OSS.
caption.zh: 展示商家端与用户端请求如何进入 Spring Boot 服务，并连接 Redis、MySQL 与阿里云 OSS。

alt.en: System architecture diagram connecting merchant and customer clients to Spring Boot, Redis cache, MySQL, and Aliyun OSS
alt.zh: 系统架构图，连接商家端和用户端、Spring Boot、Redis 缓存、MySQL 与阿里云 OSS

en: Developed merchant backend managing employees, dishes, categories, and set meals with pagination
Implemented mini-program caching for dishes and set meals, improving frontend interaction efficiency
Built shopping cart management (add, view, clear) and order submission workflow
Designed payment flow with simulated WeChat Pay integration for smooth user ordering experience
zh: 实现商家端员工、菜品、分类与套餐管理，并支持分页查询
实现菜品与套餐缓存，优化用户端交互响应效率
完成购物车与下单流程开发，打通关键交易链路
设计模拟微信支付流程，提升下单体验完整性

description.en: A city-based carpooling platform supporting drivers posting trips, passenger route matching, order generation, and message notifications. Based on microservices architecture with high availability and real-time communication, covering registration, trip publishing, ride invitations, and complete payment workflow.
description.zh: 基于微服务的同城拼车平台，支持行程发布、路线匹配、订单处理与消息通知，覆盖从注册到支付的完整流程。

intro.en: See how passengers find a suitable route, drivers publish trips, and confirmed rides move through order and payment steps.
intro.zh: 通过路线匹配、司机发布行程和订单履约流程，了解乘客如何找到合适的同行路线并完成拼车。

caption.en: Origin, destination, and travel time narrow down available trips so passengers can compare nearby routes and seats.
caption.zh: 根据起终点与出行时间筛选可用行程，乘客可以比较顺路路线、出发时间和剩余座位。

alt.en: City ride route-matching interface with a map, passenger and driver routes, and matching trip cards
alt.zh: 同城拼车路线匹配界面示意图，展示地图上的乘客与司机路线以及匹配行程卡片

caption.en: Drivers set their route, departure time, available seats, and fare before publishing a trip for passengers to discover.
caption.zh: 司机填写路线、出发时间、空余座位和费用后发布行程，供乘客搜索与邀请同行。

alt.en: Trip publishing form with route, date, available seats, fare, and a route preview
alt.zh: 行程发布表单示意图，包含路线、日期、剩余座位、费用和路线预览

caption.en: A ride invitation progresses through confirmation, payment, and trip completion, with status updates keeping both sides informed.
caption.zh: 拼车邀请依次进入双方确认、支付和行程完成，各阶段通过订单状态与消息通知保持同步。

alt.en: Ride order journey showing invitation, confirmation, payment, trip completion, and real-time status updates
alt.zh: 拼车订单流程示意图，展示同行邀请、双方确认、支付、行程完成和实时状态通知

en: Developed User module with personal info, password modification, and document uploads
Integrated Baidu OCR for automatic vehicle and identity document recognition
Designed trip fare calculation algorithm using Decorator pattern with map API integration
Implemented order timeout handling and WebSocket real-time push for smooth user interaction
zh: 完成用户模块开发，支持资料维护、密码修改与证件上传
接入百度 OCR，实现证件信息自动识别
使用装饰器模式实现计价算法，并结合地图 API 完成路径计算
实现订单超时处理与 WebSocket 实时推送，提升交互体验

html.#exp-project-4 li:nth-child(2): 负责智能运维监控系统测试（设备监控、能源管理、告警通知、数据分析等微服务模块），并支持测试环境搭建与回归验证，提升复杂场景问题复现与验证效率。
